description: Upload a screenshot or media image for a software from a local file path. Valid types: "screenshot" (default) or "logo". Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, max 5 MB per image. Aim for at least 3 screenshots - the review agent scores presentation on them. Use delete_media to remove an uploaded image, update_media to reorder. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the image on disk

name: upload_screenshot
title: Upload a Crela screenshot
